# MemberAccessOnNonObject

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="native" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs)

Report a method call or property access on a value that the code itself
shows is never an object. Calling a method or writing a property on a scalar
or an array throws an `Error`; reading a property raises a warning and yields
null.

## Example

```php{4}
<?php
function label(int $id): string
{
    return $id->name;
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Access this member on an object, not int.</li>
</ul>

## Detection

- A method call or a property read or write through `->` or `?->`.
- The type of the receiver comes from native declarations only (typed
  parameters, properties and returns, literals, operations), and without null
  every member of it is an int, a float, a string, a bool or an array.

## Exceptions (no report)

- A receiver of unknown type, or one that may be `mixed`, `object`,
  `iterable`, `callable` or a class.
- A receiver that can only be null, which PossiblyNullAccess covers.
- A type that comes only from PHPDoc, which
  DocumentedMemberAccessOnNonObject covers.
- A property read inside `isset()`, `empty()` or on the left of `??`,
  which PHP evaluates without complaint.

## Fix

None.

## PHP versions

No gating.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MemberAccessOnNonObject": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file):

```php
// @custos-ignore MemberAccessOnNonObject
```
